licence.scope: Owner is the Special Astrophysical Observatory of the Russian Academy of Sciences (SAO RAS; SCORPIO is a BTA 6-m instrument). Statement from the SAO RAS 'Acknowledgments for publications' page (owner's publication terms, level 2); it requires reference to the telescope and equipment plus a funding acknowledgement, is not a formal licence, and does not cover the filter-profile files specifically. Source page SVO cites: not recorded in info.json (empty). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: Observations with the SAO RAS telescopes are supported by the Ministry of Science and Higher Education of the Russian Federation.
